constraints: If menu is a MenuRef (menu reference), the process parameter is unnecessary and is ignored if passed.

overloadMerges.note: Added the -1 sentinel value documented for menuItem.
overloadMerges.semanticRole: Get the current font style (bold/italic/underline combination) of a menu item.

sentinelValues.meaning: the last item added to menu

params.name: process
